items.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021
items.q: When I got the gig with Liza Minelli for a while, which is 1979

ctx.x: You know. When I got the gig with Liza Minelli for a while, which is 1979, which I was definitely the 15th call or something because they had asked Lawrence Feldman my friend. They got to the saxophones to ask about piano players. And so Lawrence Feldman recommended me. So you know when a saxophone player is recommending you that they’ve gone down the list of people. But all these guys were studio guys in New York and didn’t want to travel. So I got a chance to do that, get very well paid for a little while, and…
Did you have to be ready to play songs that you knew in different keys with Liza or with female singers?
